content.user_title: Explore Open Targets Drug Discovery Data
content.value_statement: Drug discovery teams need fast access to target, disease, evidence, and drug data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Open Targets GraphQL workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search targets, diseases, and drugs by name or identifier.
Retrieve target annotations including tractability, safety, genetic constraint, and disease associations.
Retrieve disease profiles with therapeutic areas, synonyms, targets, and known drugs.
Collect target-disease evidence by data type and source.
Review known drugs, mechanisms, clinical phases, indications, and withdrawal notices.
Explain Open Targets scores and evidence types using bundled reference guides.
limitations: Requires internet access to the public Open Targets Platform API.
Exploratory API calls are not designed for large systematic studies.
Scores support prioritization but do not predict clinical success.
Clinical and regulatory decisions require expert review of primary sources.

use_cases.title: Prioritize targets for a disease area
use_cases.description: Find associated targets, compare evidence types, and review tractability and safety signals.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a gene target
use_cases.description: Retrieve gene annotations, disease links, known drugs, and safety liabilities for one target.

use_cases.title: Map clinical precedence
use_cases.description: Identify known drugs for a disease and summarize mechanisms, targets, and clinical phases.

prompt_templates.title: Find an entity identifier
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Open Targets skill to find the best target, disease, or drug identifier for BRCA1, Alzheimer disease, or aspirin.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a target profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Open Targets skill to summarize tractability, safety, genetic constraint, and top disease associations for ENSG00000157764.

prompt_templates.title: Compare disease evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Open Targets skill to compare evidence types for a target-disease pair and highlight the strongest and weakest signals.

prompt_templates.title: Build a prioritization memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Open Targets skill to create a target prioritization memo for a disease, including evidence, tractability, safety, known drugs, and caveats.

output_examples.input: Search for Alzheimer disease and summarize the top target evidence.
output_examples.output: A concise research summary with the disease identifier, leading associated targets, evidence categories, score caveats, and next validation steps.

output_examples.input: Assess BRAF as a therapeutic target.
output_examples.output: A target profile covering gene identity, tractability, safety liabilities, genetic constraint, associated diseases, known drugs, and interpretation notes.

output_examples.input: Find known drugs for a disease and explain mechanisms.
output_examples.output: A table-style narrative listing drug names, targets, mechanisms of action, clinical phases, statuses, and limitations for repurposing analysis.

best_practices: Start with exact Open Targets identifiers before requesting detailed evidence.
Compare multiple evidence types instead of relying on one aggregate score.
Use data downloads or BigQuery for large studies instead of repeated API calls.
anti_patterns: Do not treat Open Targets association scores as clinical success probabilities.
Do not use text-mining evidence alone for target selection.
Do not run large batch analyses through the exploratory GraphQL API.

faq.question: Does this skill require an Open Targets account?
faq.answer: No. The GraphQL API described by the skill does not require authentication.

faq.question: Can it query targets, diseases, and drugs?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper script includes search and retrieval functions for targets, diseases, drugs, evidence, and associations.

faq.question: Does it provide medical advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes public research data and requires expert interpretation for clinical or regulatory use.

faq.question: Can I use it for large-scale analysis?
faq.answer: Use Open Targets downloads or BigQuery for large studies. The skill focuses on exploratory GraphQL queries.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How current is the data?
faq.answer: Open Targets updates the platform periodically. Check the Open Targets release notes before final analysis.
